resources.string: Share app names with paired parents?

App-name sharing is optional and off by default. You can pair without it. If enabled, user-app names, packages and Android UIDs are uploaded for paired parents, including new-install alerts. Icons and app contents are not uploaded. Turning it off requests removal of the app snapshot when online; existing history/events and copies already downloaded by a parent are not deleted by this setting.
